MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:6 the discount triggers on `qty > 10` instead of `qty >= 10`, so a 10-item line (spec: "10 or more") gets no 10% discount, undercharging/overcharging versus contract; remediation: change the condition to `qty >= 10`.

MUST-FIX src/cap.js:5 the cap is `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1`, e.g. subtotal=100 caps at 51 instead of 50, letting the discount exceed the 50% limit and violating "round down"; remediation: `Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal / 2))`.
MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 the upper bound is `Math.min(98, ...)`, so clampQty(99) returns 98 instead of 99, deviating from the inclusive 1..99 range; remediation: use `Math.min(99, Math.max(1, q))`.

MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 the discount divides by 1000 instead of 100 (`Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000)`), so couponCents(1000, 10) returns 10 instead of 100 — a 10x undercharge that also propagates into checkoutTotal via src/checkout.js:6; remediation: divide by 100.
MUST-FIX src/fee.js:5 the fixed component is `+ 3` instead of `+ 30`, so every card fee is 27 cents too low; remediation: `Math.round(amount * 0.029) + 30`.

MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:5 `Math.round(cents / 100)` rounds up at .5 boundaries instead of rounding down per full 100 cents, e.g. pointsFor(150) returns 2 instead of 1; remediation: `Math.max(0, Math.floor(cents / 100))`.
MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:5 the check is `cents > 1000`, so a 1000-cent order — spec says "at least 1000 cents" — is rejected; remediation: `cents >= 1000`.

MUST-FIX src/refund.js:5 the restocking fee uses `Math.min(100, ...)` (capped at 100) instead of the spec's floor of at least 100 cents, e.g. paid=10000 refunds 9900 instead of 9500; the "never below 0" clause only stays meaningful with a floored fee; remediation: `const fee = Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05)); return Math.max(0, paidCents - fee);`.
